title: LiveBench v1: Coding AI Models (2026-06-25)
desc: LiveBench v1 Coding, release 2026-06-25, captured 2026-11-08. Arithmetic mean of available task scores in the publisher’s category mapping; tasks have equal weight. Higher is better on this benchmark only. Model IDs preserve reasoning-effort and fine-tuning variants; rows are evaluation configurations, not unique model families. Missing scores are excluded, not treated as zero. Different releases and v1/v2 are not directly comparable.

source.name: LiveBench v1 — 2026-06-25 release
source.note: AllRanks assistant verified on 2026-11-08: every included model ID and numeric cell against the directly fetched official CSV; category membership, averaging and overall weights against the official categories JSON and deployed application code. Arithmetic mean of available task scores in the publisher’s category mapping; tasks have equal weight. All source rows retained where a score is available, including fine-tunes/effort variants. This is source reconciliation, not an independent model evaluation. Archived raw inputs and SHA-256 hashes: docs/audits/2026-11-08-ai-rankings/.
